name: TRUE CAB
descriptionEng: HYBRID IR cabinet bank. IR slots: AMT112, AMT212, AMT412, YE112, 1960A, 1960B, ME212, ME412. DSP cost is deliberately understated. If clicks or crackling occur, reduce FIR length or disable one channel.
